messages:
hannah_cs: Kicking off Echoforge onboarding thread. Goal: pilot -> gated prod in ~3 weeks. Need owners for SSO, daily export, perf, cost reconciler, and an exec summary. Can we confirm owners and immediate risks? :wave:

omar_impl: I can own integration (SAML + export). Quick Q: pilot only SAML or should we plan SCIM in parallel?

liu_eng: From infra: SAML only for pilot. I'll own staging/perf. Heads-up: they run long document assembly (~7k tokens) in one flow. We'll want a model-variant eval.

nora_pm: Product success criteria: (1) SAML login + 2 test users; (2) daily CSV export validated against Snowflake schema; (3) median chat latency <250ms, embeddings p95 <2s during 48h pilot; (4) cost-per-10k-tokens documented and within target. Exec demo must show cost delta vs incumbent.

chris_renewals: Renewal context: renewal in Q4. Main risk is unpredictable token spend and lack of reconciliation. I'll prepare a one-pager for finance and request baseline spend from them.

hannah_cs: Proposed owners: Hannah = CS lead, Omar = Integration lead, Liu = Eng perf, Nora = PM liaison, Chris = Renewal liaison. Any changes?

omar_impl: Fine. I'll draft an "integration artifacts" Confluence page: IdP metadata checklist, sample CSV fields (include route_id, token_count), retention & encryption notes.

liu_eng: Perf plan: I'll spin a staging route and run two 24h profiles: (A) interactive daytime; (B) overnight batch embeddings. Need traffic shape from Nora. Also will include A/B: full precision vs 4-bit quantized.

nora_pm: Sending traffic profile and anonymization instructions in DM. Echoforge wants prompts sanitized before upload; we'll offer a small sanitize script.

hannah_cs: Quick WIP timeline:

```
- Day 0: internal kickoff + owners confirmed + request IdP metadata
- Week 1: SSO setup + baseline capture + cost A/B eval (quant vs full)
- Week 2: Integration + daily export validation + 48h pilot load window
- Week 3: Perf tuning, runbook, exec demo, renewal one-pager and handoff
```

omar_impl: For export cadence they requested daily CSV at 02:00 UTC. I'll include transfer TLS + AES-256 at rest in the checklist. Do they need signed assertions?

nora_pm: They prefer signed SAML assertions. I'll confirm IdP metadata and finance contact.

chris_renewals: Action list for today: 1) Omar - Confluence integration doc + data contract (EOD). 2) Liu - staging perf plan + A/B template. 3) Nora - traffic profile + anonymization instructions. 4) Hannah - request IdP metadata and baseline spend from customer. 5) Chris - draft renewal one-pager.

notify-bot: Event scheduled: "Echoforge Internal Onboard Prep" Tue 10am PT  calendar invite sent.

hannah_cs: Thanks team — I'll consolidate before our prep meeting. :tada:
